# `state/uso/USORegistry.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/uso/USORegistry.js`

state/uso/USORegistry.js — the unspent-output set + double-commit detector.  Tracks which outputs currently exist (unspent) and which have been consumed (spent). Enforces the core safety invariant: an output is never committed as spent twice (spec §19). A spend transaction's inputs must ALL be currently unspent; on commit they move to the spent set and the new outputs are created atomically by the caller (CommitCoordinator).

| `isUnspent` | `isUnspent(id)` | True if the output id is currently unspent (available to consume). |
| `isSpent` | `isSpent(id)` | True if the output id has already been consumed. |
| `get` | `get(id)` | Get an unspent output by id, or null. |
| `checkSpendable` | `checkSpendable(inputIds)` | Double-commit detector: validate that EVERY id in `inputIds` is currently unspent and that there are no duplicate ids in the request itself. Returns the conflict reason instead of throwing so the coordinator can emit a witness either way. |
| `applySpend` | `applySpend(inputIds, outputs, byTx)` | Atomically consume inputs and create outputs. Validates spendability first; if any input is unspendable, NOTHING changes. Returns the result so the coordinator can record a witness. |
| `unspentIds` | `unspentIds()` | Snapshot the unspent-output id set (for state roots / debugging). |
